verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a broad public REST API covering Payments, Payment Links, Subscriptions, Chargebacks, Balances and Webhooks. It also documents auth methods with scoped tokens, idempotency keys, an isolated test mode, and an llms.txt index with markdown mirrors. Its official MCP server proxies this same public API, and the docs and MCP pages are confirmed by probes. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end.
